narration: Banks want you terrified of your credit card. But that fear is costing you over a thousand dollars a year — there's a legal trick hiding inside it.
visual: Dark background. Giant SVG credit card centered. Scared person silhouette with dollar signs floating away. Title text: 'THE $1,100 TRICK BANKS HIDE'.

narration: Every credit card gives you up to 55 days to pay with zero interest. That window is called the float — and most people waste it completely.
visual: Light background. Horizontal timeline with 'PURCHASE' on left, 'DUE DATE' on right, '55 DAYS FREE' highlighted in green arc above. Calendar blocks animate in.

narration: Instead of paying from checking, charge everything to your card. Then park that money in a high-yield savings account earning 4.5% interest.
visual: Dark background. SVG credit card on left with arrow pointing right to a piggy bank. '4.5% APY' label grows above the piggy bank. Coins flow along the arrow.

narration: On $2,500 in monthly spending, that float earns $93 a month. Across a full year, that's $1,116 — from money you were going to spend anyway.
visual: Light background. 12 rising bar chart columns animate up one by one labeled Jan–Dec. Dollar counter ticks up to $1,116 at the end. Green accent bars.

narration: There's one rule that makes this work: set autopay for the full balance every month. Carry even one dollar over and you lose all the gains instantly.
visual: Dark background. SVG calendar with a green checkmark animating in. Shield icon below. Warning text: 'AUTOPAY FULL BALANCE' flashes in. Credit card with lock icon.

narration: Open a high-yield account today and set up autopay. You just turned your bank's own weapon against them. Follow for more moves like this.
visual: Dark background. Piggy bank SVG fills up with coins spring-animating in. 'START TODAY' bold text. Person silhouette giving thumbs up. Green glow effect.
